profile.headline: Love talking about Go
profile.summary:
I am very passionate about the outdoors, and love to go hiking in the mountains.

I am a Software Engineer at KBR. I have had experience working on Full-Stack applications, utilizing Spring and React. I love using Golang for my side-projects, and enjoy reading Jon Bodner's book, "Learning Go".
